info.title: SKU.io — Map Product Accounts with Account Rules
info.description: Turn a customer's per-product GL spreadsheet into a few SKU.io account rules (by category, brand, supplier or product type), keep true exceptions as product overrides, and save only after explicit approval. Use for the Launch Roadmap's "Map GL accounts" step or a product GL sheet.

get.summary: How the catalog splits: the company default account per type, the existing rule count, and for each dimension (category, brand, supplier, type) its groups { id, name, product_count }, how many products it covers and how many have no value.
The existing rules in order (first match wins), each with its conditions, accounts, match_count and is_active. Paginated.

post.summary: Creates one rule (same body as preview-rule, plus optional position, is_active and channel_accounts_take_priority). A blank position puts it above the first broader rule. Needs the accounting.manage_settings permission.

get.summary: Products with sku, type, brand_id/brand_name, default_supplier_id/default_supplier_name, primary_category_id/primary_category_path, tags, each *_nominal_code_id override and the resolved *_account with *_account_source (product_override, rule, company_default).

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Page size. Iterate page to last_page.

schema.description: Page size. Iterate page to last_page.

parameters.name: filter[search]
parameters.description: Matches SKU, name and other searchable fields.

schema.description: Matches SKU, name and other searchable fields.

get.summary: The chart of accounts: { id, code, name, type, archived_at } per account. Rules and overrides take these ids, not account numbers. Archived accounts are excluded by default.

post.summary: Read-only. Given a dimension and accounts per group, returns the rules it would create, the products whose own override disagrees (exceptions), totals (will_change, on_company_default, keep_override) and the before/after account map. Saves nothing.

groups.description: One entry per group to give accounts: { id, accounts: { sales, cogs, inventory, inventory_in_transit, accrued_purchases, discount } } with nominal code ids. Group ids come from get-setup-dimensions (a product type's id is the type name). Omit an account to leave it on the company default.

use_rule_product_ids.description: Product ids whose overrides should be cleared so they follow the new rules.

channel_accounts_take_priority.description: When true, a sales channel's own sales, COGS and discount accounts win over the new rules.

post.summary: Writes the previewed rules above any existing ones (never edits or deletes a rule) and clears the overrides named in use_rule_product_ids. Same body as preview-setup. Products move in a background job. Needs the accounting.manage_settings permission.

Read-only. What one draft rule would do: matches, will_change, a by-account breakdown and a sample of products that move. Use for a rule the setup dimensions can't express (a tag, a SKU prefix, or two conditions together).

conditions.description: Any of category_ids, include_subcategories, category_scope (primary|any), brand_ids, supplier_ids, product_types, tag_ids, sku_prefixes (max 5). All set conditions must match.

accounts.description: Account type → nominal code id (sales, cogs, inventory, inventory_in_transit, accrued_purchases, discount).

get.summary: Where the catalog posts now: per group, how many products post to each account and whether from rules, overrides or the company default, plus anomalies (products unlike 80%+ of their category).

parameters.name: account_type
parameters.description: sales, cogs, inventory, inventory_in_transit, accrued_purchases or discount.

schema.description: sales, cogs, inventory, inventory_in_transit, accrued_purchases or discount.

get.summary: Resolved accounts for up to 200 products: per account type the account, its source, the override id, and whether a rule would apply (rule_would_apply, rule_account).

put.summary: Sets a single product's own account override. Send only the *_nominal_code_id fields being set. Not available through the SKU.io MCP server's api_write; there, leave exceptions to a person.

sales_nominal_code_id.description: Nominal code id for this product's sales override.

cogs_nominal_code_id.description: Nominal code id for this product's COGS override.
